title: Manual Copilot Credits Import Row
description: Schema for the manually exported per-agent Copilot Credits CSV (from the Microsoft 365 admin center or Power Platform admin center). There is no supported API egress for this data today; rows are imported with source_method=ui_export_csv and a SHA-256 of the source file. Column names vary across portal versions; the importer maps observed headers to these fields and rejects unmapped files.

export_timestamp_utc.description: When the admin exported the CSV.

agent_name.description: Agent display name as shown in the portal.

agent_id.description: Agent id if the portal export includes it.

user_or_group_scope.description: User UPN, group, or scope the consumption is attributed to.

service.description: e.g. Copilot Studio, M365 Copilot Chat.

policy_or_environment_scope.description: Billing policy id/name or environment id/name.

quantity_unit.description: Credits and messages are different units; record which the export used.
